newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CBANK DRAINS SKK 2.5BLN IN REV REPO TENDERS.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CBANK DRAINS SKK 2.5BLN IN REV REPO TENDERS.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday it had drained funds totalling 2.5 billion crowns ($89.8 million) through two securities reverse repurchase tenders.
In the NBS's one-day reverse repo tender, the average rate rose to 16.32 percent, after 13.98 percent in the previous reverse repo tender of a similar maturity.
In the central bank's three-day reverse repo tender, the average rate firmed to 16.42 percent from 14.8 percent in the previous three-day reverse repo tender.

The NBS added the one-day tender was oversubscribed, with 1.7 billion crowns worth of bids from a total of 2.1 billion being accepted, while all bids for the three-day tender totalling 800 million crowns were accepted.
The NBS holds tenders on a daily basis, if needed, instead of quoting securities repo and reverse repo rates.
